title: Genome assembly efficiency: overlap seeding
summary: Incubated pilot testing a wider Hifiasm minimizer window with strict assembly-quality, runtime and memory checks on small synthetic genomes.

credit.policy: Credit accepted contributions and reproducible negative results in CONTRIBUTORS.md and result packages; retain upstream attribution.

requirements.note: 10 GiB free before build; ARM Mac requires Rosetta for Hifiasm. Native ARM Linux not supported by this pilot build.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.
